description: Observed-order-of-accuracy sweep for grids/cartesian_uniform_1d/rules/lax_friedrichs_D_inflow_bc driven by problems/advection_1d_inflow_lax_friedrichs.esm (model AdvectionLaxFriedrichsInflow), loaded once per resolution with the loader-API metaparameter binding (esm-spec 9.7.6 binding site 4) -- no per-resolution fixture files. The manufactured steady solution cos(pi x) is held by the exact forcing c dGdx with left inflow gL = u*(0) = 1 (derivation and the inflow/outflow-compatibility argument in the problem file); the recorded L2/Linf errors at t=0.1 are the pure 1st-order Lax-Friedrichs truncation drift, expected to fall as O(dx). LxF reduces to upwind for a linear flux, so these errors match tests/conformance/convergence/advection_1d_inflow_upwind to the bit. The inflow wall gradient u*_x(0)=0 keeps the boundary-cell residual O(dx) and the outflow is non-reflecting, so the observed order is a clean 1; order_tolerance is the standard 0.2.

scope_excluded.go: rewrite-only port; no makearray lowering / simulator
